title: Coffee Stall — short handoff & temporary runbook
content:
Purpose: quick, grab-and-go handoff for the coffee-stall shift (late-night smaller team) — focused on what changed, active mitigations, and bite-sized commands.

State at handoff (02:00):
- All core clusters green in Datadog except gpu-pool-3 showing elevated pod restarts (see alerts).
- Batch-queue latency: 95th percentile ~420ms (historical baseline ~220ms). Likely due to a recent retry loop from model-cache service.
- No ongoing deploys. Last infra rollout (k8s node image) completed ~06:00 UTC earlier today.

Recent incidents / what I saw:
- 00:15 — transient spike in 503s from hosted-api-us-east. Root cause: backing process OOM in model-cache v2. Quick fix: scaled model-cache to +2 replicas and bumped memory.
- 23:40 — aborted canary for infra PR #876 due to increased tail latency; rollback performed and ticket JIRA-2337 opened.

Active alerts to watch:
- datadog:gpu-pool-3_pod_restarts > 5 in 5m (channel #oncall-gpu)
- datadog:hosted-api-5xx_rate > 1.5% (channel #prod-alerts)
- pager:batch-queue-latency-95 > 350ms (pager on for eng-sre rotation)

Temporary mitigations in place:
- model-cache scaled to 4 replicas (from 2) in staging-like pool. Will hold for +2 hours while we watch.
- Automatic fallback on route hosted->small-model is enabled for requests exceeding 1s.
- Alert silence created for node-image-upgrade noise until 03:30 (silence id: silence-20260218-0030).

Quick commands (copy-paste):
- Check pods restarting: kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | grep model-cache- | awk '{print $1, $4, $5}'
- Increase model-cache replicas: kubectl -n infra scale deployment/model-cache --replicas=4
- Roll back a canary (if necessary): /ops/scripts/rollback-canary.sh hosted-api-<canary-id>
- Tail logs (last 1h errors): gw logs --env=prod --service=model-cache --since=1h --level=error

Tickets and PRs to track:
- JIRA-2337: investigate model-cache OOMs — assigned to Marisol. Links to heap profiles in ticket.
- PR #876 (infra node image): rolled back; watch for reattempt later today.
- JIRA-2401: customer report of embeddings flakiness — low priority for this shift, but avoid bulk embedding jobs overnight.

Escalation contacts (order):
1) On-call SRE (primary): Ethan Zhang (slack @ezhang, phone x2456)
2) Senior infra eng: Marco Liu (@marco, phone x3122)
3) Eng manager on-call: Priya Nair (me) — escalate if cross-region outage or SLA breach.

Notes to next shift / things I want checked:
- Follow-up: confirm whether the OOMs correlate with a recent model change (v2) vs memory leak. If memory growth steady, grab pmap from the pod at 30s intervals.
- If gpu-pool-3 continues > 8 restarts in 10m, consider cordoning the affected nodes and draining new pods to gpu-pool-5.
- Re-check scheduled cron job embed-refresh at 03:00 — I muted that job for now; re-enable only after confirming queue backlog < 500.

Temporary procedural change (note):
- For the overnight window until 2026-02-19 08:00, prefer vertical scaling (replica bump) to immediate rolling restarts for model-cache unless memory usage is flat. Rolling restarts have triggered higher tail latencies earlier.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who owns the recent model-cache changes? I saw a merge from infra-team but need author name.
- Confirm whether the canary rollback produced any DB schema mismatch warnings (I didn't see any but curious).

Quick health checklist for incoming on-call (5 mins):
1) Datadog: check hosted-api 5xx and batch latency graphs last 30m.
2) kubectl get pods -A | grep CrashLoopBackOff — fix or scale as needed.
3) Confirm no deploys in flight: /ops/deploy-status.sh
4) Confirm silence windows: datadog list-silences | grep silence-20260218-0030

Personal scratch items (not official):
- Left a comment on PR #876 asking for a smaller canary size (2%) next time.
- If time allows, run heap profile capture script on model-cache for 10m sample.

Slack shortcuts & channels: #oncall-gpu (gpu alerts), #prod-alerts (high-level), #eng-sre (triage). Use /ops escalate <name> to page.

If anything looks like a regional outage, escalate immediately and ping @oncall-manager. For everything else — adjust replicas, mute noisy alerts, and add notes to the ticket.

End of handoff — leaving the doc as a quick scratchpad. If you take over, add a one-line summary at the top with time and a short note of anything you changed.

Signed: Priya Nair (shift handed off at 02:00 UTC, 2026-02-18)
